Photo of Ageratina altissima in flower. This is a native plant growing wild in River Bend Park, Fairfax county Virginia, USA. This species is a member of the Asteraceae family.
Nom français : eupatoire rugueuse. Nom anglais : common white snakeroot. Capitules (bractées involucrales, fleurons tubulés) d'eupatoire rugueuse, vue de côté.
Location taken: The United States National Arboretum, Washington DC. Name: Ageratina altissima
